item.title: 5 Smart Home Upgrades Worth Making for a More Connected Home
item.summary: Most people think “smart home” means voice assistants and colour-changing light bulbs. In practice, the upgrades that pay off aren’t the flashy ones. They’re the boring, high-impact changes that quietly cut your energy bill and remove a dozen small annoyances from daily life. Here are five worth making, in the order they’re worth making them.
